verses.gurmukhi: ਚੰਦ੍ਰਮਾ ਅਛਤ ਰਵਿ ਰਾਹੁ ਨ ਸਕਤ ਗ੍ਰਸਿ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਹੁਇ ਸੂਰਜ ਗ੍ਰਹਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: cha(n)dhramaa achhat rav raahu na sakat gras dhirasaT agochar hui sooraj grahan hai ||

en.bdb: With the presence of the moon, Rahu cannot devour the Sun, But when the Sun hides from the moon, the solar eclipse takes place. (Here the moon is symbol of noble person in whose company the maya does not devour the hot natured Sun).

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਛਮ ਉਦੋਤ ਹੋਤ ਚੰਦ੍ਰਮੈ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਪੂਰਬ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਸਸਿ ਕੇਤੁ ਖੇਤ ਹਨਿ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: pachham udhot hot cha(n)dhramai namasakaar poorab sa(n)jog sas ket khet han hai ||

en.bdb: East and West are the directions of Sun and Moon respectively. When two days after the new moon day, the moon becomes visible in the West, all salutes him (according to Indian traditions). But on full moon day, the moon rises in the East and it is not eclipsed. (Company of a noble person is like Cool moon that is the means of protection of the hot-tempered Sun. On the contrary, company of hot Sun-like person becomes a source of distress for the cool-tempered moon).

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਸਟ ਮੈ ਅਗਨਿ ਮਗਨਿ ਚਿਰੰਕਾਲ ਰਹੈ ਅਗਨਿ ਮੈ ਕਾਸਟ ਪਰਤ ਹੀ ਦਹਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: kaasaT mai agan magan chira(n)kaal rahai agan mai kaasaT parat hee dhahan hai ||

en.bdb: The fire remains hidden in wood for long but as soon as wood touches fire, it burns (Here fire is symbolic of low sinful man whereas cool-minded wood is shown as a God-fearing person).

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤਿ ਅਸਾਧ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਮ ਕੈ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੁਸਹ ਸਹਨ ਹੈ ॥੨੯੬॥
verses.translit_en: taise siv sakat asaadh saadh sa(n)gam kai dhuramat gurmat dhuseh sahan hai ||296||

en.bdb: Similarly, keeping company of wicked-minded self-willed persons, one has to suffer pain and distress but keeping company of Guru-oriented persons, one achieves salvation. (296)
